honest_verdict: 30K random search + 1K paired-bootstrap fine-tune found a brier_delta of -0.000375 vs the in-search parent with 95% CI [-0.001823, 0.001210] which crosses 0. real_lift=false on n=29 WC2026 actuals + 563 backtest. Baseline coefficients (K_factor=40, HOME_ADV=0.4, POISSON_B=1.6, DC_RHO=-0.08, no Heuer decay) are kept. The large negative vs_baseline_brier_delta (~-0.089) is partly an artefact of the search corpus mixing in calibrated backtest rows; the within-search CI is the honest test of additional lift on top of the existing isotonic calibrator. Re-run after MD2+ graded actuals.
